summary: Synchronize side-scroller browser-input pose assertions and cold WebKit canvas readiness without weakening their requirements.

spec.reason: The run artwork and live hitbox invariants remain unchanged.

design.reason: Only browser-test input and initial-canvas readiness changed; production movement and rendering are unchanged.

validation: The test requires browser ArrowRight input to reach Phaser key state and render hero-run-art while the live body moves.
Browser ArrowRight, X, and Shift input must reach Phaser key state before the production movement, attack, and guard handlers are exercised.
A cold WebKit document may reload once, but the same visible Canvas requirement and normal test timeout remain active.
Idle, attack, guard, hurt, and unchanged hitbox assertions remain active.
limitations: Physical iOS and Android devices remain unverified.
